items.headline: Nvidia in talks to guarantee ~$250B financing for OpenAI's SoftBank-backed Ohio campus plus up to $350B in chip financing
items.note: Deepens the circular vendor-financing web (Nvidia backstopping the purchases of its own chips) underpinning the AI infrastructure debt build-out that credit investors are watching for contagion risk.

items.headline: Rising corporate borrowing costs threaten to squeeze heavily-indebted neoclouds and hyperscalers
items.note: Goldman Sachs' chief credit strategist warns that widening spreads will push AI capex funding toward private markets and JV structures as syndicated credit gets pricier, a direct signal of rising financing stress.

items.headline: Mag7 index posts worst day since April 2025 as Big Tech earnings collide with investor revolt over AI spending
items.note: Marks a break in the market's tacit tolerance for unchecked AI capex, coming right before Microsoft/Meta/Amazon/Apple report — a leading indicator for how capex guidance will be priced this week.

items.headline: 5-year CDS on Oracle, Amazon, Google and Microsoft hit multi-year highs as bond-market anxiety over AI capex grows
items.note: CDS spreads on the group ex-Oracle hit their highest since at least 2018 as fixed-income investors demand more compensation for hyperscaler AI-debt risk, a concrete credit-market stress signal.

items.headline: Alphabet posts first-ever negative quarterly free cash flow after lifting 2026 AI capex guidance to $205B
items.note: Shares fell ~7% and dragged the Mag7 index to its worst session in over a year, the clearest realized AI-revenue/capex disappointment so far this earnings season.
